Dear KeHE Deductions,

This is to inform you that we dispute claim R-0000939, which was taken on 2015-10-30. The amount in dispute is $615.44. According to our records, the correct spoils allowance for this store and period is $410.30 (0.0100 of $41,029.56 invoiced). Therefore, the amount to repay is $205.14. The dispute deadline was 2016-04-27, and this deadline has passed.

We look forward to your prompt resolution.

Sincerely,

Northfield Pantry Co.
